requirements_summary: Throughput guarantee: customer asks for explicit minimum tokens/sec at cluster level — target: 300k tokens/sec sustained during trading hours (NA region).
- concurrency caps: firm cap of 320 concurrent sessions for low-latency chat paths; additional reranking + embedding workloads should be isolated in separate queues.
- burst window: allow 10x burst for up to 90s during market open; bursts should be met by reserved capacity first, fallback to burst pool with documented throttling policy.
Latency SLOs: p95 < 250ms for 64-token chat responses, p99 < 500ms; embedding requests p95 < 150ms.

Reserved GPU planning: proposal currently sized at 8 GPUs reserved for steady-state, 12 GPUs reserved for peak/burst; auto-burst to extra reserved pool requires explicit pricing and pre-approved billing triggers.
SLA negotiation points: credits for missed min tokens/sec measured weekly, formula tied to percent below floor; a maximum aggregate credit cap per month requested by customer.
Monitoring & measurement: customer requires token/sec telemetry at 1-minute granularity, per-route KPIs, and access to tracepoints for debugging slow requests.
Fallbacks & routing: prefer model variants in same family if primary model unavailable; must maintain semantic parity for reranking or A/B degrade paths.
Data and security constraints: all inference must run in VPC with audit logs shipped to their SIEM; keys via HSM; no model weights to leave customer-controlled subnet for private deployment.
Acceptance criteria for POC: sustained 300k tokens/sec over 4-hour simulated trading window with allowed burst behavior and verified telemetry; signed performance report.
